cases.why: The page sets a '_ga' cookie via an inline script at DOMContentLoaded before any consent interaction. The perDocument extractor emits PRIVACY_COOKIE_BEFORE_CONSENT on the cookie join scope keyed by '_ga', and evaluate() produces a finding with ruleId 'privacy-cbf-cookie' and severity 'serious'. GDPR Art. 7 requires freely given, specific, informed, and unambiguous consent before placing non-essential cookies. GDPR Recital 32 clarifies that pre-ticking or inactivity does not constitute consent.
